orpheus.screen.title: Orpheus Music
orpheus.screen.tab.settings.tooltip: Timing and behavior for the selected situation.
orpheus.screen.tab.songs.tooltip: Choose which songs play in the selected situation and how often.
orpheus.screen.situation.tooltip: Survival, the Nether, the main menu and so on each have their own settings and song list. Use the arrows to switch.
orpheus.screen.enabled.tooltip: Turns Orpheus on or off for everything. While it is off, Minecraft plays its own music.
orpheus.screen.preset.tooltip: A preset is a saved set of all your settings. Click to switch, create or delete presets.
orpheus.screen.source.tooltip: Orpheus plays the songs you choose. Minecraft leaves this situation to the normal game music. Click to switch.
orpheus.screen.delay.min.tooltip: After a song ends, Orpheus waits at least this long before starting the next one.
orpheus.screen.delay.max.tooltip: After a song ends, Orpheus waits at most this long before starting the next one.
orpheus.screen.repeat.tooltip: A song is not picked again until this many other songs have played. Set it to 0 to allow repeats.
orpheus.screen.reset.tooltip: Restores the default songs for this situation. Your other settings are kept.
orpheus.screen.songs.minecraft: Minecraft is playing the music in %s.
orpheus.screen.songs.use_orpheus: Let Orpheus play the music here
orpheus.screen.song.toggle.tooltip: Click to add this song to, or remove it from, %s.
orpheus.screen.song.missing.tooltip: [!] This song's audio is not in your game yet. Use the download button at the top of the list.
orpheus.screen.chance.tooltip: How likely this song is to be picked compared with the others, from 1 (rare) to 10 (often). Click to raise it.
orpheus.screen.block.tooltip: Blocked songs are never played in any situation.
orpheus.screen.unblock.tooltip: Allow this song to be played again.
orpheus.presets.title: Orpheus Presets
orpheus.presets.name: Preset name
orpheus.presets.switch.tooltip: Click to switch to this preset. The one marked with * is in use.
orpheus.presets.delete.tooltip: Deletes this preset. You always keep at least one.
orpheus.presets.copy.tooltip: Creates a new preset from the settings you are using now.
orpheus.presets.blank.tooltip: Creates a new preset with the default settings.
orpheus.download.button.tooltip: Downloads the missing songs from Mojang's own servers into a resource pack folder. Nothing is bundled with this mod. Afterwards, enable the "Orpheus Music" pack in Options > Resource Packs.
orpheus.download.progress: Downloading songs, this can take a minute...
orpheus.download.done: Done! Now enable the "%s" resource pack.
orpheus.download.already: Already downloaded. Enable the "%s" resource pack.
orpheus.download.partial: Downloaded %s songs, %s could not be downloaded (see the log).
orpheus.download.failed: Download failed. Check your connection and the game log.
orpheus.screen.type.tooltip: Game Tracks are Minecraft's background music. Leftover Tracks are songs from the Minecraft albums that never made it into the game. Music Discs are the jukebox discs: turn them on in a situation to play them as normal music. Click to switch.
orpheus.leftover.button.tooltip: These songs are not in Minecraft's files, so they cannot be downloaded. This creates a resource pack folder with instructions. Add your own .ogg files there (for example from an album you own), enable the "Orpheus Leftovers" pack in Options > Resource Packs and reload.
orpheus.leftover.failed: Could not create the folder. Check the game log.
orpheus.screen.song.leftover.tooltip: [!] Not in Minecraft. Add your own file named %s to the "Orpheus Leftovers" pack. The button at the top of the list sets up the folder.
